import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/deps'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from planning import solve

def big_job(nreq, noff, npairs, seed=1):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    import ipaddress
    requests = {}
    for i in range(nreq):
        requests[f'R{i:04d}'] = {'id': f'R{i:04d}', 'at': 10, 'lease': 'L0',
                                 'target': str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(0x20010db8000000000000000000000000 + 1 + i)),
                                 'service': 'S0', 'group': rng.choice(['q0','q1','q2','q3']),
                                 'address': 0x20010db8000000000000000000000000 + 1 + i}
    offers = {}
    for i in range(noff):
        offers[f'O{i:04d}'] = {'id': f'O{i:04d}', 'time': 15, 'service': 'S0',
                               'prefix': '2001:db8::/32', 'capacity': 8,
                               'cost': rng.randrange(0, 10**9), 'group': rng.choice(['p0','p1','p2','p3']),
                               'requests': [], 'network': ipaddress.IPv6Network('2001:db8::/32')}
    allreq = sorted(requests)
    for k in range(npairs):
        rid = allreq[k % nreq]
        oid = f'O{k % noff:04d}'
        offers[oid]['requests'].append(rid)
    for o in offers.values():
        o['requests'] = sorted(set(o['requests']))
    ctx = {'requests': requests, 'offers': offers, 'services': {'S0': 'tcp'},
           'leases': {'L0': {'id':'L0','start':0,'end':100}},
           'request_quotas': {n: {'id': n, 'parent': p, 'capacity': c} for n, p, c in
                              [('q0',None,4096),('q1','q0',4096),('q2','q0',4096),('q3','q1',4096)]},
           'request_paths': {},
           'offer_quotas': {n: {'id': n, 'parent': p, 'capacity': c} for n, p, c in
                            [('p0',None,4096),('p1','p0',4096),('p2','p0',4096),('p3','p1',4096)]},
           'offer_paths': {}}
    active = {rid: True for rid in requests}
    return ctx, active

for nreq, noff, npairs in [(500, 500, 4000), (1000, 1000, 8000), (2000, 2000, 32000)]:
    ctx, active = big_job(nreq, noff, npairs)
    t = time.time()
    res = solve(ctx, active)
    dt = time.time() - t
    print(f'req={nreq} off={noff} pairs={npairs}: resolved={res["resolved"]} cost={res["cost"]} time={dt:.2f}s')
EOF
